III, 74ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ההן פ׳ מהו וכ׳</he> is it permitted to cross the court (of a synagogue, to use it as a shortcut)? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:3:3">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>עבר פ׳ דבי מדרשא</he> crossed the court of a school house.—Pl. <he>פַּרְוָורַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q01639"><he>פַּרְוָרַ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 27:28">Targ. Ez. XXVII, 28</cite> (h. text <he>מגרשות</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 26:15">Ib. XXVI, 15</cite> (h. text <he>איים</he>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 26:18">ib. 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 25:34">Targ. Y. Lev. XXV, 34</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="Q01680"><he>פַּרְוִילֵי</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Ketubot 54a:14">Keth. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>בבל וכל פַרְוָורָהָא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>פַּרְוָודָהָא</he>) Babylonia and all her dependencies (the places following her usages); <he>נהרדעא וכל פרוורהא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>פַּרְוָודָהִי</he>) Nehardea and all her dependencies.
